findings: Family-name checks use deontic/tdfol/cec/frame_logic against actual view-name keys; current fake fixtures reproduce wrong key shape rather than real evaluate output.
Absent/empty autoencoder report yields no disagreement for a compiled projection with all projected families.
Runner serializes truncated source text and strict status before later inference/Lake demotions; exported rows can remain stale roundtrip_ok while progress/queue says gap.
No require_workspace_logic_tree or explicit accelerate dependency pin in standalone runner.
No explicit line-search-attempt bound, checkpoint SHA pin or resource reservation in runner. --train-state path-only comparison cannot detect a hardlinked archived checkpoint alias.
enqueue-every is declared but not used; pending gaps and session rows accumulate until end, making interruption lose undelivered queue evidence.
Exported/bridge norm dictionaries strip conditions, exceptions, temporal data and all but first rule in family projection; family presence alone is not semantic agreement.
